title: Harmony Engine research seed library
status: Research and proposed design data; not integrated with the existing repository.

conventions.root_offsets: Chromatic semitones relative to Home, even in minor. No double lowering of b3/b6/b7.
conventions.formula_intervals: Semitones above chord root; retains compound extension identity before modulo 12.
conventions.bass_offsets: Independent semitone offsets relative to Home; may be a non-chord pedal.
conventions.essential_intervals: Across total harmony including bass, not necessarily all in the upper hand. Small voice budgets may require a simpler labelled variant.
conventions.quality_templates: Curated realizations, not claims that every voicing must include every listed extension.
conventions.target_null: No automatic target assignment. A runtime movement operator must supply target identity where applicable.
conventions.audition_timing: Optional quarter-note beat lengths; do not auto-quantize manual playing.

movement_rules.name: Revoice in place
movement_rules.operation: Keep root and bass. Invert or respread upper voices; retain locked melody.
movement_rules.guardrail: Do not interpret an inversion as a new key.

movement_rules.name: Extend in place
movement_rules.operation: Add or replace one allowed colour tone while preserving defining tones.
movement_rules.guardrail: Extra notes do not imply greater directional pull.

movement_rules.name: Diatonic step
movement_rules.operation: Choose adjacent degree roots and match appropriate qualities.
movement_rules.guardrail: Check whole voicings, not root membership alone.

movement_rules.name: Third relation
movement_rules.operation: Try roots a diatonic third apart; retain shared upper notes.
movement_rules.guardrail: Do not always choose the closest bass inversion.

movement_rules.name: Dominant of target
movement_rules.operation: Construct dominant root (t + 7) mod 12; resolve toward t.
movement_rules.guardrail: Require a target; a dominant quality alone does not define function.

movement_rules.name: Related two five
movement_rules.precondition: explicit major or minor target t
movement_rules.operation: Prepend ii at (t+2) then V at (t+7); choose m7 or m7b5 from target context.
movement_rules.guardrail: Offer as an optional gesture sequence; do not auto-play extra events.

movement_rules.name: Tritone substitution
movement_rules.operation: Replace dominant root with (t+1) mod 12; spell its guide tones correctly.
movement_rules.guardrail: Only substitute a functionally appropriate dominant; recheck melody.

movement_rules.name: Leading diminished
movement_rules.operation: Use dim7 at (t-1) mod 12, leading into target.
movement_rules.guardrail: Fully diminished and half diminished are distinct qualities.

movement_rules.name: Common tone diminished
movement_rules.operation: Find a dim7 containing a stable target tone and resolve neighbour voices back.
movement_rules.guardrail: This is not automatically a leading-tone diminished resolution.

movement_rules.name: Minor plagal
movement_rules.operation: Move IV to iv6 then I, prioritising scale-degree 6 to b6 to 5.
movement_rules.guardrail: D in Fm6 is natural; this is not Fm7.

movement_rules.name: Backdoor
movement_rules.operation: Offer ivm7/9 then bVII7/9/13 then I.
movement_rules.guardrail: Backdoor bVII and tritone-sub bII are different mechanisms.

movement_rules.name: Suspension release
movement_rules.operation: Move chord fourth down to third before target arrival; preserve bass.
movement_rules.guardrail: A sus chord may also stay suspended in a modal setting.

movement_rules.name: Chromatic approach shape
movement_rules.operation: Transpose upper voicing +/-1 semitone, then land on original target.
movement_rules.guardrail: Preserve a clear exit; may clash with a held melody.

movement_rules.name: Pedal transformation
movement_rules.operation: Keep bass while changing upper harmony or an inner voice.
movement_rules.guardrail: Chord root and bass must be distinct data fields.

movement_rules.name: Line cliche
movement_rules.operation: Track root/major7/minor7/6 as one moving line against a stable minor foundation.
movement_rules.guardrail: Prefer one moving strand; do not unnecessarily revoice everything.

movement_rules.name: Sixth diminished
movement_rules.operation: Alternate inversions of major/minor6 and dim7 built a whole tone above.
movement_rules.guardrail: State is a tonic-region ornament; avoid silent Home changes.

movement_rules.name: Modal colour
movement_rules.operation: Use characteristic modal tones with tonic bass reinforcement.
movement_rules.guardrail: The same collection can imply different centres.

movement_rules.name: Diatonic planing
movement_rules.operation: Translate the shape by scale steps; interval sizes may change.
movement_rules.guardrail: Do not confuse with constant-semitone transposition.

movement_rules.name: Chromatic planing
movement_rules.operation: Translate all voices by the same semitone distance.
movement_rules.guardrail: Parallel voices are intentional; preserve shape instead of minimising motion.

movement_rules.name: Chromatic mediant
movement_rules.operation: Try same-quality triadic cores a major or minor third apart; manage extensions separately.
movement_rules.guardrail: Common tones must be recomputed after extensions.

movement_rules.name: Upper structure
movement_rules.operation: Add a chosen triad over third and seventh; derive actual resulting tensions.
movement_rules.guardrail: An upper triad does not replace the shell or define the bass.

movement_rules.name: Symmetric collection
movement_rules.operation: Choose subsets and transformations within the selected collection.
movement_rules.guardrail: Symmetry weakens unique tonic information; retain user Home separately.

movement_rules.name: Deceptive arrival
movement_rules.operation: Offer a context-compatible alternate target such as vi in major.
movement_rules.guardrail: Not every dominant must resolve to I; preserve melody.

movement_rules.name: Common tone modulation
movement_rules.operation: Retain a common pitch, introduce a new region, and confirm Home only on user action.
movement_rules.guardrail: Local target is not global Home; no silent re-anchoring.
